# v1.13.2

## What's fixed

- **Update check no longer says "GitHub nedostupan" on phones sharing one Wi-Fi (mobile):** the check hit `api.github.com` unauthenticated, where GitHub allows only ~60 requests per hour **per IP** — two phones on the same network share that budget, so the second phone often got a silent 403 and a bare "Nije moguće provjeriti (GitHub nedostupan)". The check now sends proper API headers (GitHub requires a User-Agent), retries once after 2 s, caches the last successful result for 5 minutes (several phones / repeated taps burn no rate budget), and the failure message says exactly what happened (rate limit with retry time, no network, or no published release).
- **Test push button now heals an unregistered phone (mobile):** "Testiraj Google push" re-runs the full Firebase init + token fetch + backend registration before testing — a phone that missed its registration at boot (no Play services response yet, permission dialog) no longer needs an app restart; pressing the button registers it.
- **Push registration survives a failed token fetch (mobile):** if the FCM token could not be read at boot, the next resume/re-login retries the fetch automatically (previously the app stayed token-less until the process restarted). The Android notification permission dialog is requested only once instead of on every resume.
- **Server test push reports every device (backend):** `POST /api/me/push/test` now sends the test message to **all** registered devices of the account (it previously reported success after only `rows[0]` — on two-phone accounts "sent" could mean only one phone got it). Devices Google rejects as unregistered/expired are pruned and counted in the answer, and Google's rejection now carries a plain-Croatian hint (sender mismatch = APK built with a different Firebase project than the server key).
